lines: You flashed the platform lamp. Nobody’s done that in years, so I flashed back.
I’m Odi. I grow for whoever comes through. Mara, Wren, the hotel lot when they remember me.

choices.label: I just wanted to see who answered.
effects: say:odi:Well. Now you have. Come back when you want greens.

lines: Up the service lift on my back wall. People paid to sleep there once. Our parents, some of them.
It’s busy now. Ellis kicks a ball around the loading floor. There’s a scavenger who’d sell you your own boots.
Four beds. One lamp that works. Seedlings stretch for light and fall over.
I saw a lamp swinging off your pack. Or there’s the signal battery on the platform, if you ran a cable down. Or keep your gear: you’ve got a climb ahead of you, I can tell.

choices.label: Lend her a lamp
choices.detail: One more bed lit. You go without until you ask for it back.
choices.locked: You don’t have a lamp to lend.
effects: say:odi:I’ll look after it. Ask when you need it.

choices.label: Run permanent cable
effects: say:odi:All four. I don’t know what to say.

choices.label: Keep the gear
choices.detail: Her beds stay as they are. Nobody’s owed anything.
effects: say:odi:Fair. It’s a long way up.

choices.label: Could I have my lamp back?
effects: say:odi:Here. The far bed will manage.

choices.label: How do I get to the hotel?

lines: Wren walks the line between everyone. Trays to me, cans from Mara, gossip both ways.
If somebody’s moving through, Wren knows them.
The service lift on my back wall. Pull the gate, it goes up to the lobby. Bring something back if you find trays.
Beans, chard. Whatever the seed packets say. My mother grew grass, before. On purpose. Then cut it every week.
I still want to know what she did with the cuttings.

choices.label: I have no idea.
effects: say:odi:Nobody does. I never asked her.
